problem_statement: The frozen Ours cache stores raw independent positive cosine scores, but the evaluator preset labels the path scoring=relevancy and loads canonical negatives without consuming them on this cache branch. This is an interface-contract omission, not a field-capacity limitation.

candidate.positive_scores: existing immutable raw independent normalized-cosine cache
candidate.negative_scores: new immutable cache materialized from the identical descriptor rows/scales and the already-frozen canonical prompts: object, things, stuff, texture
candidate.application_point: before the unchanged frozen VALA kNN10, raw-peak scale selection, per-query min-max/2x-1 remap, fixed 0.6 threshold, and selected-only-alpha projection

gate.primary: fixed-threshold mIoU must improve on both development scenes
gate.secondary: two-scene macro mIoU must improve by at least 0.01
gate.on_success: expand unchanged to Ramen and Teatime
gate.on_failure: reject and retain the omission as a diagnosed but empirically non-beneficial protocol mismatch
